stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G025】句法歧义消除（介词短语附着、修辞辖域与比较基准排歧）；【G030】让步反驳（Concession-Rebuttal）、局限性陈述与外推边界（Extrapolation Limits）。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP001】明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 句法歧义消除（介词短语附着、修辞辖域与比较基准排歧）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 消除句子中的结构性多解（Structural Ambiguity），确保读者无需猜测修饰语究竟挂靠在哪个词上。
rules: 调整介词短语位置或改写为定语从句，消除“V + NP + PP”中的 PP 附着歧义。
明确区分绝对差值（in absolute terms）与相对变化（in relative terms），并交代基准分母（denominator）。
examples: The absolute difference was reported alongside the relative change.
common_errors: 修饰语远离核心词导致语义滑稽或产生双重解释。

grammar_instruction.name: 让步反驳（Concession-Rebuttal）、局限性陈述与外推边界（Extrapolation Limits）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 顶会论文 Limitations 章节、Rebuttal 及高分议论文的核心技能：坦诚承认方法或样本的约束条件（acknowledge constraints），同时清楚界定在什么范围内结论依然稳健（robust），并指出何时外推（extrapolation）会失效。
rules: 区分内插（interpolation，在已观测范围内估计）与外推（extrapolation，向观测年龄、工况或分布范围外推断，需更强假设）。
用 While / Although / Despite 承认局限，用 nevertheless / aún / provided that 说明受控范围内的有效性与后续改进方向（warrant further investigation）。
examples: Extrapolation beyond the observed age range requires additional justification.
The discrepancy warrants further investigation, but it does not warrant a causal conclusion.
common_errors: 要么完全隐瞒局限，要么自相矛盾地声称局限毫无影响。

grammar_instruction.name: 跨场景文体适配：顶会论文、学术演讲（Tech Talk）、个人陈述（SoP）与六级/雅思托福高分议论文
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 同一核心词汇库在不同应用场景下需要灵活切换语域与句式结构：学术论文重实证边界与方法可复现；口头演讲（Presentation/Seminar）重听众引导与简洁路标；六级/雅思托福（CET-6/IELTS/TOEFL）重观点清晰、让步权衡与具体民生/科技/教育实例。
rules: 顶会论文与审稿回复（Paper & Rebuttal）：用 We thank the reviewer for pointing out this limitation; to address this concern, we conducted an additional sensitivity analysis... 礼貌、有据地回应质疑（take issue with / respond to / clarify）。

学术演讲与海报展示（Tech Talk & Oral Presentation）：合理使用路标句（I would like to begin by explaining... / As this slide shows... / Let us now turn to... / I will leave five minutes for questions），句子宜短，避免听众无法跟上的多重嵌套从句。

六级与雅思托福写作（CET-6 & IELTS/TOEFL Writing）：摒弃万能废话模板，采用“明确立场句（adopt a principled stance）+ 具体机制解释（account for / facilitate / mitigate）+ 落地实例（concrete example，如远程教育、可再生能源补贴、公共交通可及性）+ 让步权衡（albeit / on balance / outweigh）”。
examples: Tech Talk (Spoken Academic): As this slide shows, the naive baseline performs competitively when the look-back horizon is short; let us now turn to why complex models overfit noisy series.

IELTS/CET-6 Argumentative Essay: Subsidising public transport can facilitate access to education for rural students; however, municipal authorities must weigh this benefit against long-term infrastructure maintenance costs.
Research Statement / SoP: My undergraduate project drew on multivariate time-series methods to detect sensor anomalies, which motivated my interest in robust perception for embodied agents.
common_errors: 在雅思/六级作文中使用生硬虚假的统计编造（如 *According to a 2025 Harvard survey, 93.7% of people...*），而不是使用合理的机制论证与具体生活/政策实例。
在口头报告结束语与书面论文结论之间混用语域（如在论文结尾写 *That is all I have to say, thank you for listening*）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This study/paper examines [specific problem] and aims to [verb] [measurable objective] within [stated scope].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 开门见山说明研究问题与范围，主语简短，直接用强动词 examines / addresses / investigates。
examples: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
The aim of this paper is to compare annotation rules.
common_errors: 使用冗长空洞的套话开头，或写 *address to a problem。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 界定概念的操作性定义与数学符号表示
expression_pattern_instruction.template: For the purposes of this analysis, we define [term] as [operational criterion], where [symbol] denotes [quantity].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于将抽象概念转化为可观测、可复现的操作性指标或符号。
examples: We define the outcome as the number of visits per week.
Here, N denotes the number of observations.
common_errors: 定义含糊或符号指代前后不一致。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00321 n. phr.] 混合式学习（例：The course used blended learning, combining classroom work with online tasks.）；[V00322 n. phrase] 混合式学习（例：The blended learning course combines classroom discussion with online tasks.） | 本条用法约束：指实际组合；不保证比任何一种形式更有效。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The course used blended learning, combining classroom work with online tasks.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00321 n. phr.] 混合式学习（例：The course used blended learning, combining classroom work with online tasks.）；[V00322 n. phrase] 混合式学习（例：The blended learning course combines classroom discussion with online tasks.） | 本条用法约束：强调线下和线上教学的结合。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The blended learning course combines classroom discussion with online tasks.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：blend 作动词可写 blend A with B。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The approach involves a blending of ideas from two disciplines.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：教材省连字符；名词前规范常用 blue-collar，不能机械等同阶层。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The coding guide lists blue-collar occupations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：body of 为集合表达。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A growing body of evidence supports further investigation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：knowledge 一般不可数，不写 knowledges。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The course introduces a body of knowledge about research ethics.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：body 是集合义，可换 body of research 或 knowledge。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An extensive body of literature examines access to healthcare.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：body of 后的 research 通常不可数。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A growing body of research examines commuting behaviour.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：带主观评价；若是访谈原话，应标示其来源，不能自动当作客观效果。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Participants felt bombarded with repeated reminders.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：本词条book为名词，about引出主题；about常用于一般话题，on常用于具体专题，二者并非绝对互斥。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The course uses a book about migration.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：本词条book为名词，on引出主题；about常用于一般话题，on常用于具体专题，二者并非绝对互斥。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The library holds a book on urban history.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：复数表达；具体规则取决于机构。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A reader may lose borrowing rights after repeated violations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：本单元为类比失效义；别自动译成分解或机器故障。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analogy breaks down at the level of biological repair.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：用于活动、讨论、文章等。
key_collocations: bring the discussion to a close
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The chair brought the discussion to a close at noon.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：与bring to a close近义。
key_collocations: bring the seminar to an end
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The final question brought the seminar to an end.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00341 v. phrase] 汇集；使聚集（例：The project brings together several datasets.）；[V00342 v. phrase] 汇集；综合（例：The chapter brings together findings from several studies.） | 本条用法约束：代词置中间 bring them together。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The project brings together several datasets.
